title: Transit Buffer on Prescriptions Travel Refills by Delivery Plan
content:
A travel refill of a Kestrel Prescriptions record carries the vacation override transit buffer according to the delivery plan the patient holds under Delivery & Pickup Services.

## Table

| Patient's delivery plan | Days added |
|---|---|
| an active Kestrel Mail Delivery plan | that plan's mail transit business days |
| any other active delivery plan | 1 |
| no active delivery plan | nothing |

The mail transit business days are the figure on the patient's active Kestrel Mail Delivery plan. The buffer days are added to the vacation override days supply that remains after its deductions, which is never below zero; the total is taken down to whole days and held to no more than the class's largest vacation override days supply (90 days for a Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription, 30 days for a Schedule V Controlled Prescription or a Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription).

## Readings (hypothetical plans)

- An active Kestrel Mail Delivery plan whose mail transit business days are 4: 4 days added.
- An active Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly plan: 1 day added.
- A delivery plan that is not active, or none at all: nothing added.
- A worked-down days supply of 88 on a Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription with 4 days added would be 92, held to 90.
